about.title: About
about.subtitle: Welcome to Shree Kadva Patidar Vidhyarthi Bhavan
about.establishmentContent: In the year 1929, when some students left the Shree Kadva Patidar Mahamandal Boarding, the question of creating a separate boarding to provide them with accommodation and food arose. During the session of Shree Kadva Patidar Parishad held at Daran in Kadi Taluka under the presidency of Shri Ramchandrabhai Jamnadas Amin, a demand was made by the students to start a boarding in Ahmedabad immediately to remove the difficulties faced by them. The meeting immediately took up this issue and passed a resolution on 28/12/1929 to start a hostel in Ahmedabad from 05/01/1930 and collected a fund of Rs 1500/- for this work in the same meeting. Therefore, an institution named 'Shree Kadva Patidar Vidhyarthi Bhavan' was started in a rented bungalow named 'Shanti Sadan' on Kochrab Road in Ahmedabad. At that time 35 students were admitted to this institution.
about.ownBuildingContent: Initially, in the single year of 1930, the rented house had to be changed 4 times. Therefore, the administrators decided to construct the institution's own building. Around that time, news was received that 3 bighas of land near Patidar Society in Ellisbridge area was for sale at the price of 10 annas per square yard. After that, Shri Shivabhai Bavabhai Desai of Patdi and Seth Shri Premchandbhai Ranchhoddas generously gave a loan, and on 19-04-1932, the document for that land was registered for Rs. 6275/-.
about.constructionContent: The loan amount had to be repaid to the brothers who gave the loan. Meanwhile, a letter was received from Amin Ramchandrabhai Jamnadas Vakil offering a donation of Rs 7000/- on the condition of attaching the name suggested by him to the institution. After negotiating with him, it was agreed to keep the name of the institution as 'Amin Purushottam Jamnadas Kadva Patidar Vidhyarthi Bhavan' and the donation of Rs. 7125/- was accepted. On 12/06/1932, a resolution was passed to accept the said conditional donation and on the same day, the foundation stone was laid on the land owned by the institution by the auspicious hands of Seth Shri Durgaprasad Lashkari. The process of registering rooms started with the condition of placing a plaque with the name of the donor on the room for Rs. 501/-. With the indomitable enthusiasm and love of the community, a stream of donations started flowing.
about.inaugurationContent: After spending approximately Rs 35,000/- to 40,000/-, the construction of some rooms on the west and south sides and the kitchen part was started and the inauguration ceremony of the building was performed on 09/06/1934 by the auspicious hands of Seth Shri Pransukhlal Mafatlal Gagalbhai. During this period, Shri Ranchhodbhai Dharamdas Patel gave commendable services by personally supervising as an engineer without salary.
about.historicalContent: In 1934, the minor Darbar of Patdi Shri Raghuveersinhji, Manager Shri Benjamin Saheb and other guests visited the institution. After that, many leaders of the country and especially Gujarat, Sardar Vallabhbhai, etc. visited the institution and brought glory to it. Currently, when former students of the institution living abroad come to Ahmedabad, they frequently visit their alma mater and get lost in the sweet memories associated with the institution. During the freedom struggle of the country, freedom fighters used to stay in this institution and deliver the literature of the movement to various places. Sardar Vallabhbhai addressed a meeting of freedom fighters from the terrace of the institution and he also stayed in the basement of the Bhavan for a few days during the movement. Thus, the institution has made a significant contribution to the national movement as well and that is why it has proved to be a historical institution.
about.progressContent: In the beginning of the institution, Shri Purushottamdas Lallubhai of Bavla worked with tireless effort and enthusiasm to collect funds for this institution. In 1951, after Seth Shri Ambalal Tribhovandas Taktavala became the Honorary Secretary, the progress of the institution became rapid day by day. He took pains to start the process of obtaining funds. The amount given as loan was credited to the fund account. He started the repair work by bringing a fund of Rs. 2689/- for building repairs and obtained a substantial donation of Rs. 15001/- from Seth Shri Arvindbhai Mafatlal and also obtained large amounts in donation from other merchants. He collected a fund of about Rs. 33000/- by registering life members and he himself also gifted a generous amount of Rs. 3001/- to the fund. By doing additional construction, accommodation and dining facilities were provided for one hundred and fifty students.
about.goldenJubileeContent: In 1985, the Golden Jubilee Festival of the institution was celebrated in a grand manner under the chairmanship of Shri Jaykrishnabhai Harivallabhdas. Shri Chunibhai Kuberdas Patel and Shri Shankarlal Mohanlal Guru performed successful duties as Convener and Co-Convener of the festival respectively. In the celebration of this occasion, the old and current administrators, donors, former and current students of the institution remained present, helped in the work, gave financial support as per their capacity and expressed feelings of supreme respect and gratitude towards this glorious alma mater.
about.administratorsContent: In the beginning of the institution, Seth Shri Durgaprasad Shambhuprasad Lashkari Saheb served as President from 1930 to 1936 and Seth Shri Jaykrishnabhai Harivallabhdas Saheb served from 1951 to 1985. After that, Seth Shri Laxmikantbhai Bhagubhai Saheb served from 1986 to 2006 and currently Shri Shankarlal Mohanlal Guru Saheb has been serving since 2006. Shri Purushottamdas Lallubhai Bavla served as the Honorary Secretary of this institution from 1930 to 1935 and Seth Shri Ambalal Tribhovandas Taktavala served from 1951 to 1969. After that, Shri Manibhai Girdhardas Patel served from 1985-86, Shri Chandravadanbhai Manilal Parikh from 1989-90, and then Shri Vishnuprasad Natvarlal Patel served continuously until 2006. Currently, Shri Madhusudanbhai Ramchandrabhai Amin is serving.
about.otherCommunitiesContent: Although this institution belongs to the Kadva Patidar caste, since the beginning, students of other communities are also provided with accommodation and food facilities here. And every year students of other communities take advantage of this institution, which is a specialty of this institution.
about.diamondJubileeContent: Since this institution was established in the year 1930, it has completed seventy-six years, so the time has come to celebrate its Diamond Jubilee. Many students who have studied from this institution are working on high posts in various fields and many have progressed in the business field and some are also leading in the rural sector. So far about 16000 students have studied here.

facilities.title: World-Class
facilities.subtitle: Everything You Need for Comfortable Living
facilities.accommodationDesc: Spacious rooms with comfortable beds, study tables, wardrobes, and 24/7 electricity backup. Single, double, and triple sharing options available.
facilities.messDesc: Hygienic and nutritious vegetarian meals prepared fresh daily. Separate mess facility with varied menu to cater to different tastes.
facilities.securityDesc: Round-the-clock security guards, CCTV surveillance, biometric access, and secure entry/exit monitoring for complete safety.
facilities.laundryDesc: Modern laundry facilities with washing machines and drying areas. Professional laundry services also available on request.
facilities.commonDesc: Spacious TV room, indoor games facility, reading room, and recreational areas for students to relax and socialize.
facilities.parkingDesc: Dedicated parking space for bicycles and two-wheelers with proper security arrangements.
facilities.internetDesc: High-speed broadband Wi-Fi connectivity available in common areas and rooms for your academic needs.
facilities.maintenanceDesc: 24/7 maintenance support for any electrical, plumbing, or other issues. Prompt response to all complaints.
facilities.infrastructure1: 4 well-maintained blocks with separate facilities for boys and girls
facilities.infrastructure2: Solar water heating system for hot water supply
facilities.infrastructure3: Power backup with generator for uninterrupted electricity
facilities.infrastructure4: Water purification system for safe drinking water
facilities.infrastructure5: Fire safety equipment and emergency exits in all blocks
facilities.infrastructure6: Ventilated and well-lit corridors and common areas
